summary: Open Text filed an 8-K announcing pricing terms and expiration results of its issuer cash tender offer for up to $300 million aggregate principal amount of its 3.875% Senior Notes due 2028, with the expiration date of September 30, 2026. The Tender Offer Consideration per $1,000 principal was set by a fixed spread over the reference U.S. Treasury yield determined by the Dealer Managers, plus accrued interest to settlement. The board approved the offer per the September 23 Offer to Purchase. The $300 million cap limits debt reduction, with settlement timing and acceptance levels the risk-arb focus.
